Bug, to fix: `countOf` (src/argv/words.ts) gives no count to a word with braces and a quoted part (`'%s,'{a..c}`), so the interpreter reads it as one word, the format; bash gives three words: the format `%s,a` and the values `%s,b` and `%s,c`.

Bug, to fix: the hedge `several` gives the roles of the expansion taken as three words (`counts`: one more than two); bash gives it two here (`a b`), and the second is the destination of the two-operand form (the new name, or an existing directory), not a destination directory.

Bug, to fix: a value the model knows that starts with `-` gives an option, but the interpreter reads the word as written, an operand (`cp $opt d` with `opt="-r a"`: bash runs `cp -r a d`, where `-r` is an option); the words after it then have the roles of another form (`d` is the destination of the two-operand form, not a destination directory).
